nodes.label: Farasa Morphological Segmenter & Part-of-Speech Tagger Engine

nodes.label: RING-0 Direct Kernel Page Mapping & Physical Memory Lock Framework
nodes.description: Low-level OS kernel execution module pinning memory pages directly to hardware DMA regions to eliminate ring-3 transition latencies during zero-copy graph traversal.

nodes.label: SHACL-SPARQL Advanced Custom Constraint Validation Component
nodes.description: W3C SHACL extension component embedding SPARQL SELECT queries within shape topologies to evaluate complex multi-node graph constraints and invariants.

nodes.label: Rényi Differential Privacy (RDP) Privacy Budget & Noise Tracking Manager
nodes.description: Strict accounting mechanism computing cumulative privacy loss using Rényi differential privacy definitions across iterative graph embedding training and query execution.
